messages.subject: Project Falcon - SPA v3 (our counter)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

We've uploaded our counter (SPA v3) to the data room. In summary we've landed escrow at 21 months and de minimis at £12,500, accepted the 24-month warranty period and 7-year tax period, and tidied the R&D indemnity wording. Subject to those, we think we're very close. Geoffrey would like to sign before the half-term break.

Amelia
